P11.rationale: Three circular donut-chart visualisations display concrete cited percentages (30%, 60%, 30–50%) with source attributions, constituting real data-bound infographics rather than empty frames, though they are relatively simple and lack richer chart types like bar or cost-math breakdowns.

P12.rationale: The page is reasonably well-filled with a large headline, two-column body text, a dark data panel, a pull-quote block, and a target-audience box, but the pull-quote section introduces noticeable white space that prevents the layout from feeling fully dense and magazine-tight.
